serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: A human-in-the-loop web application that compares manually entered or batch-manifest-supplied distilled-spirits application values with local OCR observations from uploaded label images across nineteen selected checks. The browser manages a session-only ordered queue of 1 to 300 applications, sends sequential same-origin requests, retains row results in memory, and generates local CSV or detailed JSON exports.
